title: GPT Realtime 2.1 joins the WebSocket API
summary:
GPT Realtime 2.1 joins the WebSocket API, while model listings get clearer Pollen labels.

GPT Realtime 2.1 was added to `/v1/realtime` and becomes the default when a request omits the model. GPT Realtime 2 remains selectable. The new model supports text, audio, and image input; text and audio output; tools; reasoning; and a 32,000-token context.

Quest and Paid labels now sit beside model names, with hover text explaining which Pollen balance a model uses. Clicking a model name or ID copies its ID, and a follow-up layout fix keeps the access label beside truncated titles on desktop and mobile.

The README’s Latest News was updated with July 15 changes to community models, 3D model discovery, dashboard links, and Veo 3.1 Fast tiers.

highlights.title: GPT Realtime 2.1
highlights.text: Use `GPT Realtime 2.1` through `/v1/realtime` for text, audio, and image input, with text and audio output. It is the default when you omit the model; GPT Realtime 2 remains selectable. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=GPT%20Realtime%202.1).
